answer: At dawn, a buyer seeking agents to monitor yarrow in a river delta issues a fresh nonce with each bid request. Every quote must include a memory-hard proof bound to that nonce, the job ID and the quoted terms. The exchange accepts each proof once and expires it after five minutes. Extra identities cannot recycle work or stockpile proofs before the nonce appears; flooding ten thousand quotes requires ten thousand computations. Calibrate difficulty for normal devices. Rich attackers can still buy compute, so this raises spam costs without proving uniqueness.
